FN-23GJSS-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 189
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/12/2023
Senate Bill 189 as introduced could increase the Alabama Medicaid Agency’s financial
obligations, by an undetermined amount in any fiscal year in which the Medicaid Commissioner
makes a determination, as authorized pursuant to the provisions of this bill, that an increase in
the current fiscal year’s reimbursement ceiling for nursing facilities’ allowable costs is
warranted due to any of the following: (1) a public health emergency; (2) a new federal or state
law or regulation; or (3) a statewide uncontrollable catastrophic event.

FN-23GJSS-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 189
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Greg Albritton
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/05/2023
Senate Bill 189 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of the Alabama
Medicaid Agency by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of any increase in the
ceiling for reimbursement of nursing facilities' allowable costs during a fiscal year, as
determined by the Medicaid Commissioner and provided by this bill, due to any of the
following: (1) a public health emergency; (2) a new federal or state law or regulation; or (3) a
statewide uncontrollable catastrophic event.
